_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bamidbar 10, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses directly.
translations.2: 'Make for yourself two trumpets of solid silver; they shall be for you for summoning the assembly and for setting out the camp.'
translations.3: 'And if both are sounded, all the assembly shall gather to you, at the entrance of the tent of the assembly.'
translations.4: 'And if one of them is sounded, the nobles shall gather to you — the heads of the thousands of the sons of Israel.'
translations.5: 'And blow a rousing blast, and the camp encamped in the east shall set out by it.'
translations.6: 'And blow a rousing blast a second time, and the camp encamped in the south shall set out by it; thus shall they blow a blast for their setting out.'
translations.7: 'And when the congregation assembles, blow a steady blast and do not rouse.'
translations.8: 'And the sons of Aaron, the imāms, shall sound the trumpets; and that shall be for you an ordinance forever throughout your generations.'
translations.9: 'And when you go to war in your land against the enemy who opposes you, sound a rousing blast on the trumpets; and when you trumpet before God your Lord, you shall be aided against your enemies.'
translations.10: 'And on the day of your rejoicing, and at your festivals, and at your new months, sound the trumpets over your ascent-offerings and your peace-offerings; and it shall be a remembrance for you before God your Lord. I am God your Lord — I have commanded this.'
translations.11: And it was in the second month of the second year, on the twentieth of it, that the cloud rose from the tabernacle of the testimony.
translations.12: And the sons of Israel set out on their journeys from the wilderness of Sinai, and the cloud settled in the wilderness of Paran.
translations.13: And the first of their setting out was by the command of God, by the hand of Moses.
translations.14: Then the division of the camp of the sons of Judah set out at the head, by their hosts; and over his host was Nahshon son of Amminadab.
translations.15: And over the host of the tribe of Issachar was Nethanel son of Zuar.
translations.16: And over the host of the tribe of Zebulun was Eliab son of Helon.
translations.17: Then the tabernacle was taken apart, and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set out, carrying it.
translations.18: Then the division of the camp of Reuben set out by their hosts; and over his host was Elizur son of Shedeur.
translations.19: And over the host of the tribe of Simeon was Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
translations.20: And over the host of the tribe of Gad was Eliasaph son of Deuel.
translations.21: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the sanctuary; and the tabernacle was erected before their arrival.
translations.22: Then the division of the camp of Ephraim set out by their hosts; and over his host was Elishama son of Ammihud.
translations.23: And over the host of the tribe of Manasseh was Gamliel son of Pedahzur.
translations.24: And over the host of the tribe of Benjamin was Abidan son of Gideoni.
translations.25: Then the division of the camp of the sons of Dan set out, at the rear of all the camp, by their hosts; and over his host was Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
translations.26: And over the host of the tribe of Asher was Pagiel son of Ochran.
translations.27: And over the host of the tribe of Naphtali was Ahira son of Enan.
translations.28: These are the journeys of the sons of Israel by their hosts, whenever they set out.
translations.29: Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, his father-in-law: 'We are setting out to the place which God has said — that very one I will give to you. Come with us and we will deal well with you, for God has promised the house of Israel with good.'
translations.30: He said: 'I will not go, but only to my own land and my birthplace.'
translations.31: He said: 'O good man, do not leave us, for you know that throughout the length of our sojourn in the open country, you have been for us as our eyesight.'
translations.32: 'And if you journey with us, then whatever good God shall deal well to us with, we will deal well with you from it.'
translations.33: And they set out from the mountain of God a distance of three days' journey; and the ark of the covenant of God was moving before them a distance of those three days, to choose a resting-place for them.
translations.34: And the cloud of God was over them by day, when they set out from the camp.
translations.36: And at its coming to rest, he would say: 'Return, O Lord, Your light, to the ten-thousands of the thousands of the house of Israel.'
